notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.2.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938621/6a3b0be78a6c7a40e22459bc6589d41ff2149cf9.png

Hello Real Go-Stop players,

Starting from update version 0.2.2, "Diamonds" previously obtainable through in-app purchases (IAP) will be removed from the game. The following changes will be implemented:
[olist]
 Players who have previously purchased Diamonds will receive an equivalent amount of "Gold" in compensation.
  Items and themed maps that were purchasable with Diamonds can now be purchased with "Gold"
[/olist]

Thank you for your continued support and love for our game.

notes.title: Patch Notes V_0.2.1 / Addition of Single AI Mode
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938621/6a3b0be78a6c7a40e22459bc6589d41ff2149cf9.png

0.2.1 Update Announcement

Hello, Go-Stop Players!

Thank you for your continuous support for our Go-Stop game. We have incorporated your feedback and made the following updates to enhance your gaming experience.


Update Details
[olist]
 Addition of Single AI Mode
You can now enjoy a single AI mode on your own.
Improve your skills by playing against the AI without multiplayer matching!

Help UI Added During Your Turn
Help UI has been added to prevent confusion during your turn.
Easily proceed with the game with the help displayed on the screen.

In-game Microphone On/Off Button Added
A button to turn the microphone on and off during the game has been added.
Conveniently switch the microphone on or off whether you want to chat with friends or focus on the game alone.
[/olist]

We hope you enjoy Go-Stop even more with these updates. We always look forward to your valuable feedback. Have fun playing!

Thank you.


===========================================

Hello, dear users!

The hotfix for version 0.2.1 has been applied. In this update, we have fixed the issue where users were unable to purchase themes even though they had sufficient diamonds.

We always listen to your feedback and strive to provide better service.

Thank you.

[ Appnori Inc. ]
